title: Headless module tests need a GPU-free CTest registration path
body: The editor preview test is currently registered with vixen_gtest_discover_tests(RenderGraph), which injects VIXEN_CTEST_GPU_ENVIRONMENT despite exercising only CPU document and recipe code. To satisfy SCC G3 after moving this test into VoxelDocument, I must register it with bare gtest_discover_tests so it runs with no display or Vulkan loader. Add a supported headless test registration helper that keeps normal CTest discovery while omitting GPU environment setup.

title: vixen_stage_assets must create its stamp directory
body: The first queued baseline command `bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent sccheadless --resource build --label baseline-build -- nice -n 10 cmake --build VIXEN/build --parallel 3` failed at 14% with `cmake -E touch: failed to update VIXEN/build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets/d84c1cd802b55cf9.stamp`. Inspection showed VixenAssets.cmake:57-62 writes its stamp under `${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vixen_stage_assets` but the custom command creates only the asset destination. I had to provision the missing build-tree parent with `cmake -E make_directory VIXEN/build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets` before retrying the queued build. Have vixen_stage_assets create its stamp parent in the custom command.

title: VIXEN needs a repo-local codegen gate instead of the shared generic script
body: The queued `baseline-codegen` command `bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent sccheadless --resource light --label baseline-codegen -- bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh` and a retry from the nested VIXEN directory both exited 127 because `tools/check-content-codegen.sh` does not exist anywhere in this checkout. VIXEN exposes generated contract checks as CMake `*_check` targets in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt, so I must invoke those targets through the build queue. Provide a VIXEN-local queued codegen gate or document the supported CMake check-target invocation.
